title: Blueprint Package Inspection Persistence Diagnostics / Correction
objective: Expose safe, actionable staging-summary persistence diagnostics for retained Blueprint package inspection retries without changing validation or canonical Twin content.
implementation_summary: Blueprint staging persistence now reports the failing operation, record type, compatibility constraint, underlying exception class, safe diagnostic, import identifier and inspection stage.
All candidate and summary writes remain owned by CandidateStagingRepository, including the mapping-version summary update.
Failed staging remains non-canonical and a retry rebuilds deterministic staging records from the retained immutable package.
expected_visible_outcomes: On Retry inspection, a successful retained package proceeds to Package inspected: Completed and reaches Package validated.
If staging persistence fails again, the inspection failure displays a precise safe persistence diagnostic rather than only PersistenceError.
No package content, secrets, credentials, database connection details or canonical Twin changes are exposed or introduced.
unchanged_areas: TEL-001 Twin content, relationships and Researcher output
Candidate review, promotion and canonical persistence
required_test_steps: Confirm Package inspected is Completed and Package validated is reached; if inspection fails, capture the precise diagnostic and do not repeatedly retry the same deterministic failure.
fresh_import_policy: NO — use Retry inspection on retained import bpi-run-bb0def9e29bcf261.
known_limitations: The actual enriched TEL-001 Wave 6 package is unavailable in this repository execution environment; Wave 6 runtime acceptance requires the retained-package retry after deployment.
operator_validation_status: PENDING — retained Wave 6 package retry required after deployment
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
candidate_state_impact: staging retry only; canonical state remains read-only
